query:
SELECT max(f.observed_byte_len) AS "byte_len"
                 FROM product_file f
                 JOIN product p ON p.org_id = f.org_id AND p.id = f.product_id
                WHERE f.org_id = $1
                  AND f.hash IS NULL
                  AND f.observed_hash = $2
                  AND f.deleted_at IS NULL
                  AND p.deleted_at IS NULL
